authorities.evidence: Systematic search of Bronze Age Cretan glyptic; reports AS-prefixed corpus and complete sign-list, while maintaining a broader Archanes Script Group of possible future additions.
Reassesses formula and argues for strong connection with Cretan Hieroglyphic milieu rather than treating it straightforwardly as a separate script.
Explicitly agrees with Decorte that Archanes represents a true script and discusses a core group of early seals.

external_comparanda_policy.rule: Later-discovered or external Aegean motifs compared to AS signs remain comparanda unless an explicit corpus authority admits the object.
external_comparanda_policy.example: Therasia A3 compared in later scholarship to Decorte AS*13; NOT an Archanes corpus admission.
